name: Postbag
description: Open-source agent-native form backend: create sandboxes, forms, destinations and routes via MCP tools (one tool per Postbag API operation, plus quickstart and explain).

POSTBAG_API_KEY.description: A Postbag API key (pb_live_… or pb_test_…). Mint one at https://postbag.dev/app or with `postbag login`. Not required for public sandbox create/test.

POSTBAG_API_URL.description: Base URL of the Postbag API. Defaults to https://postbag.dev — set only for self-hosted instances.
